description: This Java class 'LogView' extends TextView and implements LogNode to display log messages received through the LogNode interface. It formats log data, converts log levels to readable strings, handles exceptions, and updates the UI thread with log output.

classes.name: LogView
classes.description: A custom TextView that outputs log data received via the LogNode interface, formatting and displaying log messages.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Formats and outputs a log message, including handling exceptions and updating the UI thread.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: appendToLog
methods.description: Appends a string as a new line in the log display.
